block.comment: Measure the voltage on this analog input. On ATmega168/328, the ADC returns 0–1023; other boards may use a different ADC range. A potentiometer wiper or analog sensor connects here.
Wait for the given number of milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). This pauses the main program; avoid long waits when loop must service motors, music files or serial input.

Purpose: Print text on a 128×32 SSD1306 I2C OLED. U8x8 sends character tiles without a full pixel framebuffer. Wiring: SSD1306 I2C OLED: address 0x3C; analog read: PIN A0; I2C SDA A4, SCL A5; Potentiometer outer legs VCC/GND; wiper on the listed analog input. Common GND; use each module’s required supply. Try: Edit the heading. Keep text rows within the 128×32 display height.
